We are looking for a Staff Product Manager, Compute Platform who is passionate about running managed compute services at scale, namely App Platform, Serverless Functions, and Container Registry, and who understands that a great platform experience is built on well-run infrastructure underneath it.
As a Staff Product Manager, Compute Platform at DigitalOcean, you will join a dynamic team dedicated to revolutionizing cloud computing.

You will own the product strategy and roadmap for App Platform, Serverless Functions, and Container Registry (DOCR), the managed compute services that turn DO's Droplet fleet into a place where developers can ship without thinking about servers.

That means owning both sides of each service, the developer-facing product and the platform economics beneath it, such as how workloads are packed onto compute, what each app, function, or image pull costs to serve, and how processor, virtualization, and container runtime trends shape our roadmap.

You will report to the Director of Product and partner day to day with the Hyderabad-based Compute Cloud Services engineering team that builds the business logic, APIs, and control plane for DO Compute, as well as with our Droplet/VPC, Kubernetes, and infrastructure product peers, finance, and GTM.

The ideal person becomes the PM who can hold a customer conversation about deploy workflows in the morning and a capacity and margin conversation in the afternoon, the partner engineering trusts on architecture tradeoffs, and a core part of building out the compute platform PM group.
Application Limit: You may apply to a maximum of 3 positions within any 180-day period.
This policy promotes better role-candidate matching and encourages thoughtful applications where your qualifications align most strongly.
No Mind the Product account needed.
